title: The Seat on the Ferry's Sheltered Side
youtube_title: The Seat on the Ferry's Sheltered Side | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who helped, and helping back, keeps a home kind.
summary: At a bedroom with the hall light still on, Femi notices that Grandma Nia has already taken care of a seat chosen on the sheltered side for you. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Femi does one useful thing Grandma Nia did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
